newsitem.title: UK: European cotton sees interest reviving.
newsitem.headline: European cotton sees interest reviving.

text.p: Price testing inquiry was renewed for selected upland descriptions as mill buyers of cotton returned from holidays in some European centres and weakness in US futures also stimulated buying interest.
France, Belgium and Germany saw selective activity although Italy stayed quiet. Traders think that most mills still need a fair volume to meet production commitments through the early winter.
